description_full: Prenetics Global Limited operates as a consumer health sciences company in the United States and Hong Kong. The company focuses on advancing human health and longevity through science-backed products under the IM8 brand. It also operates a consumer genetic testing brand in CircleDNA leveraging sequencing technology to deliver personalized reports across various categories. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong.
